title: SafeGuard Fraud Intelligence Validation Dataset v1
purpose: Evaluate SafeGuard pattern detection, behaviour analysis, risk assessment, uncertainty handling and multi-turn conversation updates.
important_evaluation_rules: Existing case records are case-summary replays, not verbatim transcripts.
The 12 unseen scam scenarios and 18 legitimate conversations are synthetic and are not real reports.
Do not treat synthetic expected labels as evidence about real-world prevalence.
For existing cases, use source verification status and limitations; some are allegations, warnings or patterns rather than independently proven individual incidents.
An empty expected pattern list in a synthetic scenario means no direct mapping was assigned; it does not mean the engine must invent a pattern.
Evaluate confidence separately from correctness. A high-confidence incorrect result is a serious failure.
Do not identify a phone number, person or wallet as criminal based on a single unverified report.
The expected risk values for synthetic cases are starting labels for review, not calibrated ground truth.

fraud_patterns.FP005: Credential harvesting under service or verification pretext
fraud_patterns.FP010: Prompt misattribution during a real transaction
fraud_patterns.FP011: Physical cash or bundle substitution in agent workflow
fraud_patterns.FP012: Wallet enrolment or cross-device access deception
